verdict.rationale: Better Auth is a self-hosted auth framework, so data retention and deletion is a fair axis for it. The pack, however, documents no data-retention policy, user/account deletion, or data-purge capability. Configurable session expiry and session revocation govern login lifetime, not data retention, and community remarks about owning data in your own database describe a user-side arrangement. Both are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
